'''Br'lai''' was the [[Deity/Legends|goddess]] of the fiery [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], revered by the [[Kriek]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kriekaal]]. Kriek made sacrifices of [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] to Br'lai before crossing the molten oceans of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="Scout" />
